text:
Maria Chen: kicking off soak + autoscale tuning for asia-edge1 cluster. goal: stable 12k tokens/s sustained with p99 < 220ms for small-chat workload. starting ramp at 12:05 UTC.
Ajay Patel: ACK. what's the ramp steps?
Maria Chen: plan: 0-30m ramp to 25% traffic, 30-60m -> 50%, 60-120m -> 75%, then full. each stage hold 15m at steady for metrics.
Devon R.: note: initial node pool uses 8xA100 nodes (32GB). autoscaler config from last region caused oscillation; increasing cooldowns this time.
Samir K.: copying autoscaler snippet to chat: 
```
minReplicas: 3
maxReplicas: 40
targetUtilization: 0.65
scaleUpStabilization: 90s
scaleDownStabilization: 300s
policy:
  - type: Percent
    value: 25
    periodSeconds: 60
```
Maria Chen: good. also enabling prefix-KV warmup during ramp to avoid cold-cache latency spikes.
Ajay Patel: are we capping batch size? last time big batches pushed latency.
Maria Chen: set max_batch_tokens=2048 for chat endpoints, dynamic batching ON but limit 8 concurrent requests per GPU to keep tail latencies sane.
Devon R.: watch network egress on the first 60m — the region has lower inter-rack bandwidth until patching completes, so we'll limit cross-zone traffic by routing traffic-local when possible.
Samir K.: cost note: using burst capacity will bump commit by ~12% if we hit max for >2h. ops is OK for launch window but flagging finance. :money_with_wings:
deploy-bot: deploy started: asia-edge1/serving-v2 -> 1798201250
Maria Chen: first checkpoint after 30m. everyone on standby. oncall: @Samir K. please take handoff if anything weird after 2h.
Ajay Patel: if p99 > 250ms for two consecutive holds, rollback to model-quantized v1 with lower throughput but predictable latency.
Devon R.: adding a short probe: every 60s run `wrk` job to produce synthetic tokens and record gpu_util, p99, and token/sec. snippet: `kubectl exec -c loadgen loadgen-0 -- ./run_probe.sh --rps 200`
Samir K.: will watch dashboards: serving/p99, gpu/util/top, autoscaler/events, network/egress. set alert: p99 > 300ms for 5m -> page.
Maria Chen: excellent. post-mortem checklist: 1) soak logs + graphs 2) autoscaler event dump 3) node failure list 4) cost delta summary 5) handoff notes for infra-runbook.
Ajay Patel: noted. i'll capture commands and upload to the runbook under `region-launchs/asia-edge1/soak-2028-06-05`
Devon R.: quick FYI: if we see steady gpu_util < 40% at full traffic, we'll tighten targetUtilization to 0.55 to reduce cost.
Maria Chen: agreed. starting now. ping here for any anomalous alerts. :rocket:
